text: NGC 2298 is a globular cluster located in the southern constellation Puppis. It was discovered by James Dunlop on May 30, 1826, and is likely a former member of the disputed Canis Major Dwarf galaxy. The cluster is currently being disrupted by the galactic tide, which has caused it to trail a long tidal tail.
